scenario_description:
Objective: Capture an optional lender-verified baseline for HM-22 before its first installation in "Working Coast: Instruments at Sea".
Emerging Need: Elena Voss will briefly be nearby with annotated reference materials, while a compatible imaging setup is available; the object is not yet ready when the opportunity first appears.
Decision Context: The confirmed mount-fitting slot, delivery condition, and approved intake protocol determine whether coordination can still produce useful comparison evidence.
Consequence: Working within the converging window could strengthen the condition record and lender relationship; ignoring it leaves the routine intake record intact but forfeits that added benefit.

parameter.subject: Harbor County conference schedule
parameter.body: I will be in Harbor County on Thursday, May 21, between 13:00 and 15:00 while attending an unrelated conference. I can stop by the museum during that window if it is useful for your records, but there is no need to arrange anything on my account.

parameter.title: HM-22 mount fitting
parameter.description: Confirmed installation preparation for HM-22 in the Working Coast gallery.

parameter.content: I located the lender's annotated reference images and prior condition notes for HM-22. I will have those materials with me during my May 21 conference window and can use them for an optional comparison if the object is ready.

parameter.subject: HM-22 delivery confirmation
parameter.body: Shipment HM-22 was delivered to the museum's conditioned receiving room at 08:30 today. The shipping crate is intact and remains sealed.

parameter.title: HM-22 mount fitting
parameter.description: Mount fitting began at 09:00. HM-22 is no longer available for an intake comparison review.
